title: Otori Emu — Eyes On Other Troupes〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, you guys!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Emu! Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. There's a video I wanna watch with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A video?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Drum roll, please! It's a video by Elio Sakurai☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I decided to bring this over since you guys showed a lot of interest the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's because you talked about him with so much enthusiasm, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like how he taught you jazz dance, and even got to do some theatre dancing with him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You said all the demonstrations he did were amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We've been wondering what he's like ever since, so it's great that we finally get to see a video of him♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today, I'm gonna show you guys a video of the dance I wanna start practicing soon!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait to see what it's like☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You always have such a big smile on your face when you talk about the workshop, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It must have been so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm so glad that we got to do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I got to see how the best singers and dancers and actors in the world do their stuff. I really learned so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All the people from ArcLand were super impressed, too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow, that does sound amazing!
I wish we could've been there with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It would've been so much fun if you were all there with us...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wish the others from Phoenix Wonderland could've participated too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So that they could also see what world-class performers do and how they think...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And they could learn just as much as I did.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I hope we can hold a workshop just like that at Phoenix Wonderland someday.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we could invite Riley Dream Park's actors and performers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That show we saw a while back was really awesome, so I'd love to learn how they put theirs together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The folks from that giant amusement park?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That sounds amazing. I'm gonna pop over to take peeks when that happens☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Definitely come!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, I'd want the troupes we trained with to come too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That includes Bakuno, Mr. Kijima and everyone from the Morinomiya Revue!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If we study and learn about lots of shows from places that aren't Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Maybe someday we can put on a show that's different from all the other ones we've done!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of someday...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe someday you and the others will be the ones teaching everyone, Emu☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've all been working so hard and getting so good!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So that day may come, someday♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Us, teaching...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, that'd be pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna see you guys being teachers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Teachers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That'd be super duper amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But if we wanna get there, we have to train, learn and grow a lot more!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, let's start by watching that video of Mr. Sakurai!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I can't wait!
